title: ui: the Add holder pick's environment re-send holds only for a registry-listed name, and a user with an id-less direct grant plus a position shows neither Remove nor the position note
body:
domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUAXJEaRNwDiLuAvEZ

Follow-up of #32807 (PR #32852). Part of #31527 (ADR-0150). Visible only once #31698 PR-2 lets two packages hold one permission-set name.

Filing category: ② follow-up of a reviewed PR. reach: the epic red-line read of PR #32852 at head `b2ca1d54` (comment 6837420894, PASS-with-nits, no extra round by the #31527 rule). Re-read the lines on `main` once PR #32852 lands.

## 维护者速读

PR #32852 补了 Add 持有者选择的测试，并让没有 id 的授权行不再显示移除。复读还剩两处小问题：一是 PR 里「选本环境候选后按名重发会被接受」这句，只在候选来自注册表的持有者列表时成立；注册表不持有该名、目录退回元数据服务时并不成立。二是同一用户如果既有没有 id 的直接授权、又经岗位持有，这一行既没有移除，也没有「经岗位持有」的提示。都只影响界面，不放宽服务端判定。

## What happens (at `b2ca1d54`)

1. The re-send shape the PR pins for an environment candidate on Add is accepted only when the candidates come from the registry's holder list. When the registry does not hold the name and the catalog falls back to the metadata service, the statement does not hold; the page has no pin or wording for that path.
2. A user who has a direct grant with no `id` and also holds the set through a position gets a row with neither Remove nor the "held through a position" note.

## Expected

- Item 1: the page's handling and its wording cover the metadata-service fallback, or the pick is not offered there with the reason said; ⛔ never resolved by order. Pin it.
- Item 2: the row shows the position note whenever a position holds the set, whatever the direct grant's shape. Pin it.
- One holder: unchanged (CONTROL).

Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `views/metadata-admin/AssignedUsersSection.tsx`). Triage decides the grade; it sits on the #31527 release line after PR #32852. The server-side reading behind item 1 is filed separately for the server lane.

Related: #32807, PR #32852, #32774, #32833, #31527.
